findings.report:
## 1. Browser-local usefulness-feedback capture — pending Remi review

Add a minimal browser-local usefulness judgment on mining proposals so Remi can mark which investigations were worth considering.

**Why now:** Goal's near-term test is whether fresh runs return work Remi would consider (goal.md:17), but both native runs remain explicitly Incomplete for owner usefulness judgment.

**Evidence**
- factory/context/work-in-progress.md:19 lists usefulness-feedback capture as pending, unaccepted candidate
- apps/factory/app/components/MiningRun.vue:88-101 renders proposals with only 'Use this proposal' draft action; no usefulness control
- apps/factory/app/components/MiningStation.vue:9-18 browser history stores only session id/label/createdAt

**Existing work:** Existing pending candidate from native baseline wrun_01M2AQ0E5CN1HVCD71RC6TPGD5 (docs/verification.md:19); not implemented. Open PR #1 adds cockpit draft APIs but no feedback control; GitHub issues inventory complete with no feedback issue.

**Scope**
- Mining proposal card UI control plus localStorage persistence only
- No shared indexing, scheduled mining, deduplication, or factory-rule changes
- No implementation or approval of the candidate itself

**Acceptance criteria**
- Proposal cards offer an explicit usefulness signal that stays browser-local and never implies shared persistence or owner approval.
- Signal is stored alongside the existing session-history mechanism and remains reviewable on return.
- Remi can distinguish useful / not-useful runs when judging the near-term mining question.

**Uncertainties**
- Preferred signal shape (binary vs. short note) is Remi taste; needs owner choice
- Whether browser-local is sufficient or shared indexing later becomes justified

## 2. Bounded ADEO Jira demo scope for workshop — pending Remi review

Write the bounded ADEO Jira demo scope for the 3–4 hour workshop so later Jira slices test factory learning instead of growing unbounded features.

**Why now:** Jira remains a fixture shell and factory progress is measured by explainable capability, not shipped Jira features (goal.md:5); without a bound, the next Jira slice risks reintroducing unscoped parity work.

**Evidence**
- factory/context/work-in-progress.md:20 lists bounded demo scope as pending, unaccepted candidate
- factory/context/goal.md:29 exact compatibility subset and identity behavior need concrete demo scenarios; 'feature parity' is not an agreed spec
- packages/project-context/src/jira-reference.json:28-31 transition graph unobserved; reference snapshot is not compatibility proof
- apps/jira/app/app.vue:62-69 fixture notice plus synthetic-only list/board/details

**Existing work:** Existing pending candidate carried from native baseline and hosted review (docs/verification.md:10,58); stale-doc portion already delivered, demo-scope portion still awaiting Remi. No GitHub issue exists; both Vercel productions READY at pinned revision 3b6b8fad (dpl_2PuzWWXcCHrePBy9R3ovrdXFgoWB, dpl_A5oFTnQ7QVrEanjQYKraG7Fs9H17).

**Scope**
- Documentation/context scoping only, e.g. goal-adjacent note plus stage-copy reference
- Explicit out-of-scope list: Jira API ops, Connect, MCP, Passport-derived accounts, SAML/directory sync until demo scenarios exist
- No Jira implementation, publication, or rule activation

**Acceptance criteria**
- A short scope note names the workshop demo slice: included Jira behaviors, explicit non-goals, and deferred identity/integration targets.
- Scope references only observed statuses/types and states that the transition graph is unverified.
- No Jira feature code or API parity claim is added by this task.

**Uncertainties**
- Which 1–2 demo flows Remi wants onsite determines the slice
- Whether scope lives as goal text vs. standalone doc is an owner/format choice

## Reflection

**helpfulContext**
- work-in-progress.md explicitly frames both items as pending review, preventing novel-discovery misclassification
- goal.md:15 usefulness definition plus docs/verification.md pending-usefulness notes directly justify feedback capture
- jira-reference.json limitations plus fixture notice bound the demo-scope claim

**missingContext**
- No live usefulness judgment from Remi; this review cannot substitute for owner acceptance
- No comment threads fetched (empty inventory has no numbers); WIP supplement covers active work per map

**contradictions**
- PR #1 title/body duality in GitHub reads (returned once as issue and once as pull) is an inventory display artifact, not two units of work.

**suggestedImprovements**
- Keep pending candidates in work-in-progress.md until Remi accepts/retires them to avoid mining-loop rediscovery
- Consider a lightweight Remi usefulness rubric so future feedback capture has stable acceptance labels
